CHAPTER 15 
Applying Clinical Judgment to Promote 
Nutrition for Renal Wellness 
15.1 Assess and Analyze the Impact of Nutrition on the Renal System 
15.2 Plan Nutritional Strategies to Impact Renal Wellness 
15.3 Implement Nutritional Strategies to Impact Renal Wellness 
15.4 Evaluate Nutritional Strategies to Impact Renal Wellness 
The renal system, which comprises the kidneys, ureters, bladder, and urethra, works to eliminate 
liquid wastes from the body, manage fluid and electrolyte balance, and regulate blood pH, volume, and pressure. 
Nutrition markedly impacts this system and can affect morbidity and mortality of clients with abnormal or
